title: RJA Relational Annotation v1.1
description: Per-turn relational justice annotation. Replaces the scalar justice_score of v3.1 with a disaggregated profile + relational configuration + typed residue + audit trail. Governed by justice_charter_v1.1.yaml. NOTE: cross-dimension aggregation into a single score is prohibited by the charter and intentionally NOT representable in this schema.

turn_id.description: Anchor into the immutable Turn stream (core/datamodel.py). Required even in minimal v1.1 for forward-compatibility with the deferred trajectory layer.

relation_to_previous.description: Deferred trajectory anchor. Optional/empty in minimal v1.1; reserved so the sequence layer can be assembled later WITHOUT re-coding.

justice_dimensions.description: Disaggregated profile. NEVER summed across entries. Direction lives in `valence`.

self_positioning.description: How the speaker positions themselves (Bamberg level 1).

other_positioning.description: The NARRATED relation: how the speaker positions the other/institution (level 2).

analyst_positioning.description: The analyst's reconstruction, EXPLICITLY marked as analytic, not as the speaker's claim (level 3).

beneficiary.description: In whose favour the asymmetry runs, as narrated.

speaker_stance.description: 'legitimating'/'desiring' mark Foucault-Butler normalization / Berlant cruel-optimism points.

relation_residue.description: Set when the relation does not fit any available relation_type (charter relational_vocabulary governance = closed-with-residue).

residue.description: Typed residue. A finding, not an error. May be empty.

possible_charter_revision.description: If this residue suggests a missing dimension/relation type -> feeds the versioning loop.

overall_uncertainty.description: TURN-LEVEL global confidence in the whole coding. Distinct from per-dimension `confidence`.

revision_history.description: Required when coding is automated and the abductive loop revised fields. Each entry records a field change across loop passes.
